text: My academic thesis required an extended peer-review pause due to citation conflicts.
I am auditing the pedagogical efficacy of the assignment before committing labor.
The bibliography generator entered a recursive loop of existential dread.
Campus network packet loss suspended my submission in digital purgatory.
I was actively pursuing primary field research at the campus coffee cart.
The group project chat started arguing about fonts so I muted notifications forever.
I sat in the library for five hours, drank two boba teas, and wrote half a title.
My alarm went off, but my duvet put me in an unbreakable submission hold.
The lecture was so soothing it put my last two neurons into cryosleep.
I miscalculated the deadline by three days and two astrological eras.
The blank essay document mocked my ignorance with its glaring, heartless cursor!
Woe! The calculus textbook speaks in ancient riddles no mortal heart can bear!
My GPA stands upon a jagged cliff, whispering farewell to my diploma.
I wept upon the lecture hall stairs as the final exam bell tolled like doom.
A campus raccoon swapped my chemistry lab report with an avocado peel.
My TI-84 calculator started predicting the apocalypse instead of calculating sine.
I turned the essay into an interpretive dance, but Canvas has no tap-dance upload.
The campus squirrels formed a union and blockaded the lecture hall doors.
